correctness.rationale: Jacobian rank on hyperplane sum xi=0 forces coordinates into a projectively normalized mu_(2p) root list. Cyclotomic polynomial Phi_p forces equal positive-minus-negative multiplicity at all p residues; free scaling gives N!/(2p) weighted coefficient. Nontrivial Galois projective stabilizer forces coordinate ratios +/-1 and p-1 degree otherwise; nonzero Hessian determinant makes singularities ordinary nodes and finite etale. Burnside rotates p-tuple multiplicities. Independently enumerated normalized root lists for (p,N)=(3,5),(3,6), reproducing (A,R,Q)=(60,0,30),(340,10,165). Proof applies to odd prime p, N>=5, char0; no positive-characteristic assertion.
